campaignBrief.title: Expand your small-business practice
campaignBrief.objective: Help the agency build a repeatable, informed small-commercial preparation practice through role-specific learning and a focused next action.
campaignBrief.audienceRationale: The fictional agency has an established personal-lines book and is appointed for small commercial. Its current product mix provides a sensible learning and preparation scenario, not an underwriting or financial recommendation.

roleVariants.headline: Build your next chapter in small business
roleVariants.body: Give your team a clear starting point for small-commercial conversations. Review the learning path and choose your next agency action.

roleVariants.headline: Bring a stronger submission to the table
roleVariants.body: Start with the business story, check the state context, and use a focused checklist to prepare your next BOP request.

roleVariants.headline: Connect everyday conversations to new needs
roleVariants.body: Learn the questions that help identify a business conversation, then bring the right teammate into the next step.

roleVariants.headline: Resources for your next client conversation
roleVariants.body: Find product guidance, preparation checklists and learning organized around the work you do.

relationshipManagerBrief.headline: Align on the next small-business conversation
agenda: Ask which kinds of local business conversations the team already encounters.
Confirm the appropriate specialists, appointment context and risk-state guidance.
Choose one learning action and one submission-preparation action.
Agree who owns the follow-up and review the result together.
avoid: No promised volume, revenue target, conversion lift or quote turnaround.
Do not coach an account manager to perform activities beyond their authorization.

measurementPlan.businessQuestion: Does a role-specific learning path help eligible agency colleagues complete useful preparation actions?
measurementPlan.unit: Agency, with role-level interactions retained for diagnosis.
measurementPlan.primaryMetric: Share of eligible target agencies completing at least one selected learning or preparation action within 30 days of first campaign exposure.
supportingMetrics: Learning registration or completion where instrumented
BOP checklist or draft-submission preparation where instrumented
guardrails: No automatic coverage, pricing or eligibility action.
Verify no private agency values appear in public Edge content.
Do not claim causation from uncontrolled sandbox data.
measurementPlan.experimentNote: A future controlled holdout should assign and evaluate by agency to avoid different colleagues contaminating treatment/control. This sandbox prepares the measurement design; it does not establish campaign lift.

reviewChecklist: Source claims trace to current official source URLs.
Risk-state guidance preserved; Texas workers compensation exceptions are not simplified into blanket rules.
Principal, producer, account-manager and fallback copy differ in purpose.
Every CTA is in the approved route list.
No invented financial or underwriting promises.
Native Brand Kit is selected and reviewed.
No external send or live publishing action executed.
